claims.claim: SolarEdge Q2 2026 revenue was $346.2M, up 20% year over year, while GAAP gross margin reached 27.5% versus 11.1% a year earlier.
Q2 marked the sixth consecutive quarter of year-over-year gross-margin expansion, evidence that the recovery is extending beyond a single quarter.

factors.name: recovery breadth
factors.basis: Revenue growth and repeated margin expansion indicate improving operating quality.

factors.name: AI data-center adjacency
factors.basis: Management has identified AI data-center power as a high-growth adjacency, creating optionality beyond residential/commercial solar.

risks.risk: The recovery follows a severe prior downturn; absolute GAAP profitability remains incomplete.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of demand and margin recovery through a full solar inventory cycle remains unproven.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 GAAP operating loss narrowed to $16.0M from $115.5M in Q2 2025, while non-GAAP operating income turned positive at $10.2M.
Management entered 2026 describing a shift from recovery to profitable-growth execution, with Nexis rollout and data-center power as explicit growth paths.

factors.name: execution conversion
factors.basis: Revenue, margin and operating-loss trends provide measurable conversion of turnaround claims.

factors.name: new-market execution
factors.basis: Data-center power is strategically attractive but remains less proven than the core inverter/energy-storage franchise.

risks.risk: GAAP net loss persisted in Q2, so the turnaround should not be represented as fully complete.

unknowns.unknown: No Scout valuation or entry-price conclusion is asserted.
